title: 政策工具托底对冲美股科技抛售，订单与增持事件等待开盘确认
summary: 互换便利与回购增持再贷款加码，11月2日A/H宽度修复；但纳指跌1.1%，ORCL、MRVL、LITE、INTC与AMD同步承压。盘前以大华和协创数据作条件关注、万辰集团回避，等待开盘量价确认。

关键词云图

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗斡旋预期压低油价
伊朗与卡塔尔官员就结束美以对伊战争的安排继续接触，Brent在11月2日一度跌近6%，最终跌约7.6%。油价回落利于航空、物流和下游制造成本，但压制上游能源盈利预期。来源：Reuters、AP。
政策
央行11月3日开展互换便利操作
中国人民银行公告称，31家证券、基金公司申报需求超过1000亿元，互换期限1年并可视情展期；该工具提升机构换入高等级流动性资产后增持股票的能力。来源：人民银行公告（新华网转载）。
政策
回购增持再贷款转为长期制度
人民银行、金融监管总局和证监会表示，回购增持再贷款由阶段性转为长期安排，利率由1.25%降至1%；利好有真实实施能力的回购增持主体，不等同于所有题材普涨。来源：三部门座谈会。
美股
AI与通信硬件抛售延续
11月2日延长时段最新报价显示ORCL -8.84%、MRVL -12.73%、LITE -18.62%、INTC -8.84%、AMD -7.55%；MRVL收购LITE与AI资本开支回报担忧共同放大估值压力。A/H映射先看光模块、服务器、半导体设备开盘是否弱于指数。来源：Reuters主题追踪及运行时公开报价。
财报
苹果业绩超预期但利润率指引承压
苹果季度营收1144.8亿美元、EPS 2.10美元，高于市场预期；但假日季毛利率指引45%-46%、存储成本上升及服务增速预期偏弱，AAPL延长时段最新报价较前收跌1.61%。A/H消费电子链需等待开盘价格确认。来源：AP、MarketWatch及运行时公开报价。
产业
乌镇峰会聚焦AI开源与智能体
2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会11月2日至5日举行，议题覆盖AI开源、智能体互操作、具身与空间智能；会议催化需由订单、产品落地与开盘量价共同验证。来源：中央网信办。
公告
大华子公司中标AI超节点采购
大华股份子公司华启智慧中标中国移动2026-2027年AI超节点采购，金额约26.3亿元含税、份额4096卡；公告同时明确尚未签署正式合同，金额不等于当期收入。来源：公司公告。
增持
协创数据控股股东拟增持5亿至10亿元
计划在6个月内以自有及自筹资金增持且不设价格区间；公告提示资金筹措和实施结果存在不确定性。11月2日收于150.41元、涨2.97%，该价格发生在公告前，不能作为公告后确认。来源：公司公告。
并购
泰瑞机器拟控股存储模组公司
公司拟受让亿芯微16%股权并增资，交易后合计持股不低于51%；公司此前无存储行业经验，公告列明整合和业绩承诺兑现风险。来源：上交所公告转录。
监管
万辰集团因信披事项被立案
公司称调查涉及未及时履行关联交易临时披露义务且已整改，但立案本身构成重大监管风险；盘前无法取得一致的最新收盘报价，故不做实时强弱判断。来源：公司公告转述。
市场
前一交易日A/H宽度修复但外部科技背离
11月2日14:05 CST的AKShare盘中快照显示A股4470涨、788跌、中位涨幅1.96%，恒生科技约涨3.05%；同日美股纳指最终跌1.1%，形成内外市场背离，今日开盘需以A/H科技相对强弱决定能否延续。来源：GitHub Actions AKShare快照及AP。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
延长时段ETF代理维持科技弱、道指强的分化
运行时公开报价截至08:10-08:15 CST：QQQ 681.09美元、较前收-1.37%；SPY 752.10美元、-0.48%；DIA 519.34美元、+0.43%。三者是延长时段代理，报价为相对前收的总变化，数据源未单独拆出收盘后的增量，不能写成股指期货。
板块对照
大部分排行方向获确认，通信硬件内部出现背离
行业Top5代表股AIN +9.64%、NXT +14.91%、RKT +7.54%、DFH +11.80%、THO +7.50%，均确认正向；Bottom5中BEEP -5.36%、NBR -6.72%确认负向，NRT +5.59%、CLRO +66.57%、ICG +7.94%与所属行业方向相反，属于潜在反转/个股背离。概念Top5的BILI +6.66%、PENN +7.17%、DASH +6.22%、RCL +4.53%确认正向，XIACY未取得可靠延长时段报价。报价时间介于06:35-08:15 CST，未单独拆分盘后腿，结论仅作开盘前代理。
A/H 映射
先防AI硬件估值外溢，再看直播与内需分支能否独立
MRVL/LITE与计算机硬件、通信设备弱势对A/H光模块、服务器和芯片形成开盘压力；BILI及直播概念强势对港股内容平台提供局部正反馈，油价回落利好航空物流但压制上游能源。若恒生科技与创业板开盘后持续强于各自前收且硬件龙头不再扩散下跌，才视为国内强势消化外部压力；反之采用美股科技负向信号。

盘前结论

国内政策端偏暖：互换便利与回购增持再贷款长期化，叠加11月2日A股4470涨、788跌的盘中宽度，给券商、回购增持和有真实订单的科技公司提供缓冲。

外部科技信号偏弱：纳指跌1.1%，ORCL、MRVL、LITE、INTC与AMD同步下挫，且延长时段代理未显示明确反转；A/H光模块、服务器和半导体硬件须先看开盘相对强弱，不能沿用前一日普涨直接追高。

基准采用“国内前一交易时段宽度修复、海外科技估值承压”的冲突框架：恒生科技/创业板若开盘30分钟守住前收且硬件龙头不弱于指数，结构行情可延续；若迅速转弱，则优先控制科技高波动敞口。AKShare是11月2日14:05的盘中快照，不是今日实时。

重点个股关注

大华股份
002236.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：子公司AI超节点中标约26.3亿元含税，份额4096卡；正式合同尚未签署，11月2日收14.24元、+1.28%发生在公告前。

确认条件：今日开盘后放量站稳前收，并且通信设备/服务器链不继续受MRVL-LITE抛售拖累。

风险与失效：合同未签、交付30天与收入确认存在不确定性；若冲高回落至前收下方或板块明显走弱，条件关注失效。

协创数据
300857.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：控股股东拟6个月增持5亿至10亿元，不设价格区间；11月2日收150.41元、+2.97%发生在公告前，尚非公告后确认。

确认条件：增持开始实施并披露，且开盘后价格不跌破前收、成交与存储/服务器板块同步改善。

风险与失效：资金含自筹部分，计划可能延迟或无法足额实施；若高开低走并持续弱于板块，转为纯新闻观察。

万辰集团
300972.SZ
回避

事实与状态：公司因未及时履行关联交易临时披露义务等事项被证监会立案；盘前来源对11月2日收盘价不一致，未把不可靠报价写成确认。

确认条件：只有监管结论明确、公司完成充分整改且价格在有效交易时段稳定后，才重新评估。

风险与失效：调查与潜在处罚、治理折价和情绪冲击均未消除；当前不具备多头卡条件。

板块轮动看板

受益方向券商与回购增持、航空物流、具备明确订单的AI应用/设备
观察方向直播与内容平台、太阳能、消费电子；看BILI与Apple映射是否分化
压力方向光模块、通信设备、服务器与半导体硬件；美股通信/计算机硬件Bottom5提供负面反证
验证信号创业板与恒生科技守前收、硬件龙头相对指数止跌；否则政策利多仅作风险缓冲

逻辑链

互换便利与回购增持再贷款加码 → 增强机构与公司增持能力 → 券商及真实增持事件获得流动性支持。
11月2日A/H宽度与恒科反弹 → 国内风险偏好修复 → 但快照为盘中历史基线，不能替代今日开盘确认。
ORCL、MRVL、LITE、INTC与AMD下挫 → AI/通信硬件估值收缩 → A/H光模块、服务器与芯片先承压。
Brent大跌 → 输入成本与通胀压力缓和 → 航空物流相对受益、上游能源相对承压。
A/H若开盘后硬件不再弱于指数 → 视为国内消化外部冲击；否则沿用美股负向信号并降低高波动仓位。

风险雷达

AI资本开支回报ORCL、MRVL、LITE与半导体股同步下跌，估值压力可能跨市场传导。
美国中期选举政策和数据中心监管预期可能放大夜盘波动。
公告执行风险大华合同尚未签署，协创增持资金部分来自自筹，泰瑞跨界并购存在整合风险。
监管与治理万辰立案尚未有最终结论，相关治理折价可能扩散。
数据时效AKShare为11月2日14:05盘中快照；延长时段代理未单独拆分盘后腿，今日价格仍待开盘确认。

数据来源与时间点

美股排行：GitHub Actions / Moomoo，2026-11-03 08:28:11 CST，覆盖2026-11-02美股现金时段；延长时段代理与代表股：公开行情，最新成交时间2026-11-03 06:35-08:15 CST，抓取于08:30-08:31 CST，变动均相对前收且未单独拆分盘后腿。AKShare v1.18.94 / schemaVersion 2，fetchedAt 2026-11-02 14:05:51 CST，实际A股交易日2026-11-02、A/H均为intraday_snapshot；A股4470涨/788跌/75平、中位+1.955%，港股999涨/757跌/1049平、中位0.000%。政策与公告：人民银行、证监会、中央网信办、沪深交易所/公司公告、HKEX；发现源：金十A股盘前、财联社/科创板日报、东方财富；集中抓取截止2026-11-03 08:31 CST。港股定向核验未发现会改变恒生科技判断的新增权重股重大公告；Futu非云端前置，未使用。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicate importance, not return.
Major News
Global
Iran mediation hopes push oil lower
Contacts involving Iranian and Qatari officials kept alive hopes for an end to the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. Brent fell nearly 6% intraday and about 7.6% by the close on Nov 2. Lower oil helps airlines, logistics and downstream manufacturing costs but hurts upstream earnings expectations. Sources: Reuters and AP.
Policy
PBOC to conduct swap-facility operation on Nov 3
The PBOC said 31 securities and fund firms requested more than CNY100bn; the one-year swaps may be extended. The tool improves institutions' ability to obtain high-grade liquid assets and add equities. Source: PBOC notice republished by Xinhua.
Policy
Buyback relending becomes a permanent tool
The PBOC, NFRA and CSRC said the facility is now permanent and cut the relending rate from 1.25% to 1%. This supports issuers and major holders with credible execution capacity, not every thematic stock. Source: joint policy meeting.
U.S. Tech
AI and communications-hardware selloff persists
Latest extended-hours feed readings for Nov 2 showed ORCL -8.84%, MRVL -12.73%, LITE -18.62%, INTC -8.84% and AMD -7.55%. The MRVL-LITE transaction and doubts over AI-capex returns amplified valuation pressure. A/H optical, server and semiconductor-equipment names need relative-strength confirmation at the open. Sources: Reuters and runtime public quotes.
Earnings
Apple beat, but margin guidance disappointed
Apple posted quarterly revenue of USD114.48bn and EPS of USD2.10, above expectations. Holiday-quarter gross-margin guidance of 45%-46%, rising memory costs and softer services growth left AAPL's latest extended-hours quote 1.61% below the prior close. A/H consumer electronics still needs opening-price confirmation. Sources: AP, MarketWatch and runtime public quotes.
Industry
Wuzhen summit focuses on open AI and agents
The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit runs Nov 2-5, covering open-source AI, agent interoperability, embodied intelligence and spatial intelligence. Orders, product delivery and opening price-volume must confirm the conference catalyst. Source: CAC.
Filing
Dahua unit wins AI-supernode procurement
Dahua unit Huaqi Zhihui won about CNY2.63bn including tax for China Mobile's 2026-27 AI-supernode procurement, covering 4,096 accelerator cards. The filing says no formal contract has been signed and the award is not current-period revenue. Source: company filing.
Ownership
Sharetronic controller plans CNY0.5-1.0bn increase
The six-month plan uses own and raised funds and has no price range; the filing flags funding and execution uncertainty. The Nov 2 close of CNY150.41, +2.97%, predates the announcement and is not post-announcement confirmation. Source: company filing.
M&A
Tederic plans control of a storage-module company
Tederic plans to buy 16% of Yixinwei and inject capital to reach at least 51%. The company has no prior storage-industry experience, and the filing flags integration and performance-commitment risks. Source: SSE filing transcript.
Regulatory
Wanchen Group faces disclosure investigation
The company says the probe concerns delayed disclosure of related-party transactions and that remediation is complete, but the investigation remains a material regulatory negative. Consistent latest-close data were unavailable pre-open, so no real-time strength claim is made. Source: filing summary.
Market
Prior A/H breadth repair diverges from U.S. tech
The 14:05 CST AKShare intraday snapshot for Nov 2 showed 4,470 A-share advancers, 788 decliners and a +1.96% median move, while Hang Seng TECH was about +3.05%. The Nasdaq later closed down 1.1%, creating a cross-market divergence that today's A/H open must resolve. Sources: GitHub Actions AKShare snapshot and AP.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indices
Extended-hours ETF proxies retain weak tech and firm Dow split
Runtime public quotes as of 08:10-08:15 CST: QQQ USD681.09, -1.37% versus prior close; SPY USD752.10, -0.48%; DIA USD519.34, +0.43%. These are extended-hours proxies. The feed reports total change versus prior close and does not isolate the post-close leg, so they are not presented as index futures.
Sector Check
Most ranking directions confirmed; communications hardware shows divergence
Top-industry representatives AIN +9.64%, NXT +14.91%, RKT +7.54%, DFH +11.80% and THO +7.50% confirm positive direction. In Bottom5, BEEP -5.36% and NBR -6.72% confirm weakness, while NRT +5.59%, CLRO +66.57% and ICG +7.94% move opposite their industries, a potential reversal/single-stock divergence. Concept Top5 representatives BILI +6.66%, PENN +7.17%, DASH +6.22% and RCL +4.53% confirm positive direction; no reliable extended-hours XIACY quote was obtained. Quote times span 06:35-08:15 CST and do not isolate the post-close leg, so conclusions are provisional proxies.
A/H Mapping
Guard against AI-hardware valuation spillover; test whether streaming and domestic demand decouple
MRVL/LITE and weak computer-hardware/communications industries pressure A/H optical, server and chip names at the open. BILI and Live Streaming strength offers a local positive for content platforms, while lower oil helps airlines and logistics but hurts upstream energy. Only if Hang Seng TECH and ChiNext hold above prior closes and hardware leaders stop extending losses should domestic strength be viewed as absorbing the external shock; otherwise the U.S. tech-negative signal takes priority.

Pre-open Conclusion

Domestic policy is supportive: the swap facility and permanent buyback relending, together with 4,470 A-share advancers versus 788 decliners in the Nov 2 intraday snapshot, cushion brokers, credible ownership-increase cases and technology companies with real orders.

External technology signals are weak: the Nasdaq fell 1.1%, while ORCL, MRVL, LITE, INTC and AMD all declined, and extended-hours proxies show no clear reversal. A/H optical, server and semiconductor hardware must prove relative strength at the open rather than inherit the prior domestic rally.

The working framework is a conflict between prior domestic breadth repair and overseas tech-valuation pressure. If Hang Seng TECH and ChiNext hold above prior closes for 30 minutes and hardware leaders do not underperform, structural strength may continue; a quick break lower favors reducing high-beta tech exposure. AKShare is a Nov 2 14:05 intraday snapshot, not today's live market.

Stocks to Watch

Dahua Technology
002236.SZ
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: Its unit won about CNY2.63bn including tax for 4,096 AI accelerator cards. The formal contract is unsigned; the Nov 2 close of CNY14.24, +1.28%, predates the filing.

Confirmation: Hold above the prior close on rising volume after the open, while communications equipment and servers stop extending the MRVL-LITE selloff.

Risk and invalidation: Contract execution, 30-day delivery and revenue recognition remain uncertain. A failed gap that falls below the prior close or renewed sector weakness invalidates the watch.

Sharetronic Data Technology
300857.SZ
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: The controller plans a CNY0.5-1.0bn increase over six months with no price range. The Nov 2 close of CNY150.41, +2.97%, predates the filing and is not post-announcement confirmation.

Confirmation: Actual purchase disclosure, price holding above the prior close, and simultaneous improvement in storage/server peers.

Risk and invalidation: Funding includes raised capital and the plan could be delayed or undersized. A gap-up reversal and persistent sector underperformance reduce it to news-only monitoring.

Wanchen Group
300972.SZ
Avoid

Facts and status: The CSRC opened an investigation over delayed disclosure of related-party transactions. Pre-open sources disagreed on the Nov 2 close, so no unreliable price is used as confirmation.

Confirmation: Reassessment requires a clear regulatory outcome, adequate remediation and stable price action in a valid trading session.

Risk and invalidation: Investigation, potential penalties, governance discount and sentiment damage remain unresolved; it does not qualify for a bullish card.

Sector Rotation Board

Potential BeneficiariesBrokers and credible buybacks/increases, airlines/logistics, AI applications and equipment with firm orders
WatchStreaming/content, solar and consumer electronics; test BILI versus Apple read-through divergence
PressureOptical, communications equipment, servers and semiconductor hardware; U.S. communications/computer-hardware Bottom5 is negative evidence
ValidationChiNext and Hang Seng TECH hold prior closes and hardware leaders stop underperforming; otherwise policy support is only a cushion

Logic Chain

Stronger swap and buyback tools → more institutional and issuer purchase capacity → liquidity support for brokers and credible increase cases.
Nov 2 A/H breadth and HSTECH rebound → domestic risk appetite repaired → but the intraday historical snapshot cannot replace today's opening confirmation.
ORCL, MRVL, LITE, INTC and AMD fall → AI/communications-hardware valuation compresses → A/H optical, server and chip names face opening pressure.
Brent drops sharply → input-cost and inflation pressure ease → airlines/logistics benefit relatively while upstream energy weakens.
If A/H hardware stops underperforming after the open → domestic markets are absorbing the shock; otherwise retain the U.S. negative signal and reduce high-beta exposure.

Risk Radar

AI capex returnsSimultaneous declines in ORCL, MRVL, LITE and semiconductors can transmit valuation pressure across markets.
U.S. midtermsPolicy and data-center regulation expectations may amplify overnight volatility.
Filing executionDahua's contract is unsigned, Sharetronic relies partly on raised funds, and Tederic faces integration risk.
Regulatory and governanceWanchen's investigation has no final outcome, leaving potential governance discount.
Data freshnessAKShare is a Nov 2 14:05 intraday snapshot; extended-hours proxies do not isolate the post-close leg, and today's price still needs the open.
